answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one harbor weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The ridge report reveals the merge explicitly at each thread. Because of that, anyone who spins up 61 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 279 times the capital for one share. A farm of 4468 identities would post 2596 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
